q_x62.text: First-pass spend gate (FP-S) waits for the E2-T8 rung record; hosted-only fallback fires if G-L1 has not passed 14 days after FP-S is otherwise ready (14 is a synthesis placeholder)

fallback.rule: if G-L1 fails on both gate partitions, or has not passed by the trigger recorded at FP-S, FP-E is held in its hosted-only form: W4 runs original mini-swe-agent, Pi and Claude Code alone (phase 2 only), and P3-L2 and P4-FP are withheld{l1_not_passed} and move to a later pass (REQ-XH-123)
specifics: FP-S is "otherwise ready" when every FP-S precondition except the E2-T8 rung record is met
an E2-T8 record on C-05 rung 3 is not itself a trigger — it goes to the operator through REQ-XE-120's AR-04 amendment ADR, and if that delays G-L1, the 14-day trigger fires
once the trigger fires, FP-S no longer waits for the rung record, which only the HH-native arms need

formulas.cost_projection: p̂_h = 1.2 × max(1.5 × mean_h, P90_h) over the arm's measured trials in the current scope (W2 for FP-E; W4 at each checkpoint) when at least 10 are measured, else the binding planning prior of §10.1.5; a step fits when Σ_h (remaining slots_h × p̂_h) ≤ root cap − consumed − Σ orphaned calls at bounded.hi − C × s

per_arm_cap.admission: an arm's slot is admitted on expected cost only when consumed_h + Σ over its in-flight slots of max(p̂_h, consumed-to-date) + p̂_h ≤ cap_h; otherwise the arm's remaining slots are withheld{budget} — no cell, never a scored refusal
per_arm_cap.arms: Pi, Claude Code, V5 (unprotected); the protected pair is bounded only by the root cap and the checkpoint rule (Q-X61 recorded default)
per_arm_cap.values: formula now — values fill at FP-E from cost fields only (REQ-XH-117)

formulas.slice: REQ-XC-126: the in-flight slice headroom is C × s reserved against the root only; an arm's in-flight overshoot of its cap is bounded by its in-flight slots × (s − p̂_h) and covered by the root
formulas.wall_time: t̂_h = 1.1 × the arm's measured mean wall time per trial (W2 for FP-E, W4 at each checkpoint) when at least 3 trials are measured, else the 1,040 s prior; the HH-native arms and V5 use original mini-swe-agent's t̂; W_p = Σ_h (remaining slots_h + ⌈0.1 × remaining slots_h⌉) × t̂_h / C + overhead + load; a step fits when W_p ≤ D − the REQ-XB-128 admission cut-off (≈ 0.65 h in W4); D ≤ D_max (the largest D keeping Σ compute ceilings ≤ $20; unauthorized Wc contributes only r × 1 h + S·r_disk·h_r)
